repair.shared_evidence: The CTE requires the exact complete stored runtime/process/start/connection/pipe/fd identity, unretired runtime, Cursor row agent, launch token/life, protected path, socket/server tuple and pane tuple. Fresh proof additionally requires runtime and row session equal the confirmed next identity plus outgoing current-life history at the same path. Unchanged proof requires runtime and row still outgoing, the full existing snapshotMatchSQL predicate for the examined row and no outgoing current-life archive.
repair.supervisor: No session.go edit required. Existing rotationReconciled atomic handoff now means a positively known outgoing or fresh identity rather than any successful negative fresh query. Existing rotationObserved carries only a proven fresh commit. The intentional branch can continue with the outgoing binding after cancellation prevented Start, while unknown state remains failure. Actual owned termination, independent final hook/runtime/pane verification and protected end persistence still gate ended success.
repair.deadline: Observation remains detached from the canceled publication parent but bounded by reportUntil, which is capped at the ORIGINAL first-control deadline. QueryRowContext includes sole-connection acquisition in that budget. No retry, new allowance, rollback, publication write, unconfirmed identity adoption or recovery/replay was added.

technical_decisions_for_srd: A failed publication-hook Start is a terminal hook boundary requiring final reconciliation just as confirmed child exit does. Parent cancellation must not cancel the bounded authoritative read before its original deadline.

A false committed query is not proof of the outgoing binding. Reconciliation must distinguish known unchanged outgoing, known committed fresh and unknown/error; only the first two permit consumed intentional shutdown to continue normal verified finalization.

Keep evidence atomic in one real store snapshot. Reuse full runtime/launch/pane identity predicates and the existing full examined-row snapshot predicate for unchanged proof; require outgoing current-life history for fresh proof and its absence for unchanged proof.
Preserve the committed-only ObserveCursorRotation reader while adding a production reconciliation result for the reporter. No new hook, public fault flag or test seam is introduced.

Neither SQL identity knowledge nor hook launch failure proves runtime death or durable SessionEnd. Those remain the existing independently verified finalization obligations under the same original bound.
